name: Songstress' Snake
notes: Prior to Update (?), this creature was named Songstress' Pet.
related_quests: Forces of Nature: Help three nereid sisters reclaim an abandoned Imperial fort.
summary: The Songstress' Snake is a giant snake that accompanies Sliklenia the Songstress in Arx Corinium. When she sings, a shield appears around her pet snake that protects all within from being damaged. Keep the snake alive to use this to your advantage.
